Nora: kicking off halcyon32k int4-onboard with extended prefill to stress tiling/prefetch. target ctx=32768 prefill=30000. hitting a "back-window" repeat that looks like stale tile replay. logs below.
Ike: repro I used:
```
./spin_onboard --model halcyon32k --quant int4 --context-window 32768 --prefill 30000 --kvcache-prefetch tiled
```
Sam: symptom summary: at ~29.5k tokens, decoder emits a ~6-token fragment that matches tokens from ~27.2k. sometimes contiguous, sometimes interleaved. not purely deterministic but high p-value.
Yara: sanitized snippet:
```
[onboard] prefill=29512
[kv] fetch shard=8 tile_idx=2147483647 offset=4294967290
[decode] emitted: ... 721 834 912 721 834 912 ...
```
Ike: offset looks like unsigned wrap (-6 interpreted). suspect int32->uint64 casting in tiled index math. also seeing rope-scale mismatch between prefill-time and in-flight fetch when progressive-tiling is enabled.
Nora: perf note: enabling prefetch improves p99 by ~18% on long runs but seems to increase incidence of back-window repeats. disabling prefetch drops incidents to near-zero.
Sam: bisect shows regression introduced in kernel v1.16 where we added "optimistic_publish" for tile indices to reduce contention. good in perf but racy with eviction.
Yara: quick experiment: adding an atomic compare_exchange for tile publish + a defensive check that treats tile_idx >= MAX_TILE as abort reduced reproductions by ~98% (perf hit ~+5%).
Ike: workaround options: 1) snapshot prefixes every 8k tokens (memory overhead), 2) force hard kvcache flush at 29k boundary (latency spike), 3) reversion of optimistic_publish (perf regression).
Nora: CI: added svt/halcyon-longprefill to assert no repeated 4-token windows in prefill range 28k..30k. running now.
ci-bot: svt/halcyon-longprefill  RUNNING 
Sam: hypothesis: when optimistic_publish returns stale tile (index wraps), the prefetcher reads a tile whose rotary phase was computed for an earlier prefix length; if progressive rope scales by tile, the phase mismatch causes coherent emission of the stale content.
Yara: action items:
- Ike: push PR with safe publish (compare_exchange) + small instrumentation counters. include microbench measuring publish latency.
- Sam: expand goldset with 5 long prompts that previously surfaced back-window repeats and add them to nightly.
- Nora: coordinate a canary that disables optimistic_publish for Dedicated customers during rollout.
- Yara: add a stress job that runs with prefetch=on/off across kernel versions v1.15..v1.17 and records repeat incidence.
Ike: I'll include a unit test that feeds a synthetic negative-offset into the fetcher to assert it fails-fast.
Nora: thanks  keep updates here only. will monitor CI. :eyes:
